variants.headline: Money in hand, no food to buy
variants.sub: People have money for food but cannot buy it because shops and farms are sold out.
variants.body:
Shops and farms are sold out of food, and people with money in hand are going without. There were {short} meals that could not be bought this month for lack of food. For {target}, the central test is provision, not an explanation that mistakes an empty supply for an empty purse.

The gazette distinguishes unavailable food from unaffordable food. The reported shortfall concerns meals which could not be bought because the supply was exhausted. That distinction is material to any account of the condition and should remain clear when discussing how the colony's needs are to be met.

We defend {target} against indiscriminate blame. The lack of available food is serious, but it does not establish every claim about its cause or prove that an imagined alternative would supply the missing meals. Care in the public record is part of responsible administration.

variants.headline: Shops and farms sell out
variants.sub: Food is unavailable to buyers even with money in hand: shops and farms are sold out.
variants.body:
People can have the means to pay and still be unable to obtain a meal. Shops and farms are sold out, leaving {short} meals unavailable to buyers this month. Readers judging {target} should keep the distinction between purchasing power and actual food firmly in view when considering the shortage.

That distinction is material to any account of the condition and should remain clear when discussing how the colony's needs are to be met.

variants.headline: Food shortage defeats the buyer
variants.sub: Shops and farms are sold out of food, leaving people with money unable to buy meals.
variants.body:
The colony has recorded {short} meals that could not be bought this month because there was no food available. Shops and farms are sold out despite people having money in hand. The responsibility of {target} should be examined against that physical shortage, rather than a presumed inability of buyers to pay.
